jobs.title: IT Backend Developer
jobs.location: la Roca del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
jobs.description:
Un pedido entra en Odoo. Pasa por fabricación, por almacén, por un transportista entre los siete con los que trabajamos, y llega a casa de alguien que lo lleva esperando semanas. En algún punto de ese recorrido hay una lógica que decidiste tú. Así es construir el backend de Decowood.

Quiénes somos:

Somos una marca internacional del sector home&living. Odoo es el cerebro de la operación: pedidos, stock, fabricación, almacén y transporte. En los próximos dos años montamos la operativa multi-almacén europea, y buscamos a quien construya el backend que la sostiene.

El reto:

No vas a ejecutar tickets. Te vas a sentar con operaciones, vas a entender cómo se mueve de verdad un pedido, un abono o un camión, y vas a decidir tú la lógica de negocio que lo sostiene.

Qué harás:

Evolucionas Odoo como orquestador de fabricación, logística de entrada —materiales, importación, compras— y logística de salida.
Construyes el sistema de devoluciones de punta a punta: trazabilidad, control de entrada de mercancía y abonos automáticos.
Integras nuevos transportistas y optimizas la logística entre almacenes: stock multi-ubicación, reaprovisionamiento y rutas.
Te haces dueño de los procesos de tu dominio: defines la lógica de negocio junto a quien la usa cada día, y la llevas tú mismo a producción.

Te reconocerás en este perfil si...

Tienes 4+ años de backend, en el lenguaje que sea —Python, PHP, Java, C#...—.
Has tocado al menos un proyecto real dentro de un ERP (Odoo, SAP, Dynamics, Sage, Navision o propio), trabajando con stock o almacén.
Has integrado APIs de terceros en producción, y sabes lo que cuestan de verdad los reintentos, la idempotencia y la conciliación de estados.
Traduces una necesidad de negocio ambigua en una solución técnica hablando directo con quien la va a usar.
El testing es un hábito para ti, no un extra que se queda para después.
Has implantado o mejorado un proceso de ingeniería en un equipo: testing, CI o code review.
Tienes SQL sólido sobre base de datos relacional, y te manejas bien leyendo código ajeno de un framework grande.
Te defiendes en castellano e inglés técnico —la documentación de los transportistas está en inglés.

Cómo trabajamos:

Equipo ágil, decisiones rápidas, contacto directo con almacén y atención al cliente. Documentamos en wiki y desplegamos en CI/CD. Entre tú y el problema no hay capas de gestión.

Proceso de selección

Ágil y directo, sin vueltas innecesarias: una primera entrevista con HR e IT, y una entrevista final con CEO y Dirección de Operaciones. Dos conversaciones, y sabrás dónde estás.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Factory Automation (f/m/div)
jobs.description:
As Senior Software Engineer Factory Automation you will help us modernize production software at our Cegléd site. You’ll build and run scalable full-stack applications, replace legacy tools (MS Access, LabVIEW), and further develop our MES/QM solutions.

Your Role

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

Design and development of full-stack applications (C#/.NET, Angular,React) in a manufacturing environment
Replacement of legacy systems (MS Access, LabVIEW) with modern, scalable software solutions
Deployment and operation of applications on OpenShift (containerizedenvironments)
Implementation and further development of MES and QM system solutions at the Cegléd site
Building and maintaining reporting & monitoring dashboards using Grafana and Tableau
Database development and optimization with MSSQL, Oracle and PostgreSQL
Leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to boost development efficiency
Log management and error analysis using the ELK Stack
Independent requirements analysis in close alignment with production and business units
Close collaboration and technical exchange with the partner team in Warstein, Germany

Your Profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

Must have

Proven full-stack expertise – you're confident navigating the C#/.NET backend landscape while crafting seamless user experiences with Angular or React
Database mastery you can rely on – whether it's MSSQL, Oracle, or PostgreSQL, you know how to design, optimize, and scale relational databases with ease
Cloud-native mindset – you've shipped real-world solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift, and you're comfortable owning the full deployment lifecycle
Structured & self-driven – you don't just execute tasks, you actively shape them by taking ownership of requirements management and driving work forward independently

Nice-to-have

Experience with ELK Stack, Grafana or Tableau
Background in legacy application modernization (Access, LabVIEW, VBA)
Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot,ChatGPT-based dev tools)
Understanding of manufacturing processes and industrial data structures
Experience in agile development environments (Scrum / Kanban)
Basic knowledge of IT security in industrial application contexts
Soft Skills & General
Strong communication skills for collaboration in an international team(DE/EN)
Ability to act as a bridge between IT and production
German or English proficiency (min. B2) for collaboration with the Warstein team
Eagerness to learn and genuine interest in emerging technologies in the manufacturing domain

Contact:

Nóra, Ladányi-Balogh

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Full-Stack Engineer who enjoys building secure, scalable backend solutions and integrating modern AI capabilities into enterprise applications?  
Do you thrive in collaborative environments where you can work with real-time data, cloud-native technologies, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, business-critical solutions?  
Ready  to   grow   your   career   with  a  global  AI  and  cloud leader,  working  on  innovative   technologies   that  make a real impact  across   industries   and   markets ?  

Practical Information 

Location:  Riyadh,  Saudi Arabia  
| Work Arrangement:  Hybrid
  |  Reports to:  Service Line Delivery Lead  
|  Contract type:  Full-time  
|  Visa Requirements:  Valid Visa for  KSA  
| Language Requirements:  Fluent /professional   English ,  written and verbal , Arabic is a strong plus

We are looking for a  Senior Full-Stack Engineer
 with strong expertise in backend development, systems integration, and application deployment to help build and enhance enterprise AI-enabled solutions within a secure industrial environment. In this role, you will focus on developing robust backend services and APIs, enabling real-time data integration, ensuring application reliability, and supporting containerized deployments and production readiness. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with modern web architectures, enterprise integrations, AI/ML services, and container platforms such as  OpenShift
 and  Kubernetes
.  

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain secure backend services and APIs for enterprise web applications  
Build and enhance application services for reporting, dashboards, notifications, user workflows, administrative functions, and AI-enabled capabilities  
Integrate applications with enterprise data sources, operational platforms, document repositories, notification services, and existing backend systems  
Develop and support real-time or near-real-time data flows using  APIs,  WebSockets , Server-Sent Events
, message queues, and similar integration patterns  
Collaborate with AI and data teams to integrate model outputs, analytics services, RAG/LLM capabilities, and monitoring components into application workflows  
Support containerized deployments using  Docker 
and  OpenShift/Kubernetes
, leveraging  Bitbucket/Git, CI/CD pipelines
, release management, environment configuration, and deployment validation  
Ensure application reliability, security, and operational readiness through troubleshooting, logging, monitoring, performance optimization, patch releases, secure coding practices, testing, documentation, and close collaboration with architects, frontend engineers, DevOps, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders  

Job Requirements
Extensive experience in full-stack or backend-focused enterprise application development, with strong expertise in designing and building scalable backend services using technologies such as  Node.js, Java/Spring Boot, Python/ FastAPI /Django
, or similar frameworks  
Strong experience designing, developing, and documenting  RESTful APIs
, including secure API design, authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and enterprise integration patterns  
Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including  PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis,  TimescaleDB
, or similar technologies  
Experience deploying and operating applications in containerized environments using  Docker
 and  OpenShift/Kubernetes
, supported by a solid understanding of  CI/CD pipelines, Git/Bitbucket workflows, code reviews, branching strategies, and release processes

Proven ability to troubleshoot production issues, performance bottlenecks, integration failures, and application reliability challenges in complex enterprise environments  
Strong understanding of application security, vulnerability remediation, and secure software development practices  
Ability to work effectively in structured enterprise environments, following established processes for documentation, testing, quality assurance, and formal acceptance procedures  

What we offer

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:   
Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture ( https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values )  
A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action  
President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers  
Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities  
Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.
